# Provider contract coverage

<!-- Generated by internal/providers/contractcoverage; do not edit. Regenerate with: go test ./internal/providers/contractcoverage/ -update -->

Every provider API the gateway parses, by provider key and endpoint, with the number of contract cases
that pin it. A provider key is a native adapter, an OpenAI-compatible preset served by the openai adapter
(`<preset>@`, whose fixtures are the openai suite's `<preset>@<model>` directories), Vertex AI (`vertex@`,
the gemini adapter's `vertex@<model>` directories) or a speech-relay vendor. An endpoint is a capability
interface in `internal/providers/provider.go` that the adapter, constructed through `providers.NewRegistry`,
implements (type assertion, not a hand list); its cases are the fixtures whose `case.json` names it (`chat`
when there is none), or for the speech relay the sessions under `speech/testdata/sessions/`.

`TestCoverageGrid` fails when an implemented cell has neither a case nor an entry in
`internal/providers/contractcoverage/exemptions.json` with a reason, and when an exemption is stale; so
the covered and exempt counts below always add up to every implemented cell. The losses the cases pin are
listed in [KNOWN_GAPS.md](KNOWN_GAPS.md). That every model in the model-watch registry has fixtures is
checked by `TestRegistryMatchesFixtures` in `internal/providers/contractwatch`.

## Totals

| | |
|---|---|
| provider keys | 21: 6 native adapters, 12 OpenAI-compatible presets, Vertex AI, 2 speech-relay vendors |
| implemented cells (provider key × endpoint) | 207: **89 with contract cases**, 118 exempt |
| exempt cells | 12 unverifiable (whether the upstream serves it cannot be checked from a reachable source); 6 answered without an upstream call; 1 relayed, not parsed; 99 not served (the upstream has no such endpoint, or the gateway never routes there) |
| models | 73: 0 recorded from the real API, 73 synthetic (authored from the provider's reference) |
| cases | 383: 111 error cases; 259 recordable, 124 synthetic only (`recordable: false`, or a speech session) |
| model-watch registry | 71 covered models in 16 sections of `contractwatch/known_models.json` |

## Exemptions

From `internal/providers/contractcoverage/exemptions.json`.

### Unverifiable (whether the upstream serves it cannot be checked from a reachable source)

| provider key | endpoints | reason |
|---|---|---|
| `anyscale@` | chat, completions, embeddings, images, speech, transcription, translation, responses, list_models, assistants, vector_stores, ocr | Whether Anyscale still serves api.endpoints.anyscale.com cannot be checked: the only statement on it, the "Changes to Anyscale Endpoints API" notice (multi-tenant access withdrawn from 2024-08-01, the API only through the hosted Anyscale Platform), is on docs.anyscale.com, which the egress proxy blocks (403), as it does api.endpoints.anyscale.com and www.anyscale.com; no GitHub source carries it (anyscale/endpoint-cookbook@25ff9da22990328128a010c3b3236b1b5ab160e5, frozen 2024-03-22, shows the old surface only). Expected verdict once reachable: not served (service withdrawn). Known gap AN1, pinned by TestPresetHealth in internal/providers. |

### Answered without an upstream call

| provider key | endpoints | reason |
|---|---|---|
| `bedrock` | list_models | ListModels returns nil without calling Bedrock's ListFoundationModels or ListInferenceProfiles, so there is no upstream shape to pin; model-watch lists Bedrock itself (contractwatch BedrockLister). |
| `cartesia` | chat, list_models | The speech relay serves only its vendor's WebSocket API: ChatCompletion and StreamChatCompletion answer 501 not_supported, and ListModels lists the configured models, all without an upstream call. The relay itself is pinned by the speech sessions. |
| `deepgram` | chat, list_models | The speech relay serves only its vendor's WebSocket API: ChatCompletion and StreamChatCompletion answer 501 not_supported, and ListModels lists the configured models, all without an upstream call. The relay itself is pinned by the speech sessions. |
| `vertex@` | list_models | The gemini adapter's ListModels returns nil without calling upstream (known gap G26); the Gemini API's list_models case pins that. |

### Relayed, not parsed

| provider key | endpoints | reason |
|---|---|---|
| `openai` | assistants | ProxyAssistantsRequest and StreamAssistantsRequest relay a 2xx body or stream unparsed, so there is no shape to drift; an error body goes through parseProviderError, which the openai suite's error cases pin. No fixture: Assistants calls create objects in the account, so the drift job could not record one either. |
